name: GripGrab W's PACR Windproof Winter Jacket
description:
When the temperature drops, reach for the GripGrab PACR Windproof Winter Jacket. This softshell winter jacket will keep you comfortable during your cold bike rides.

The front facing torso, lower back and sleeves of the jacket use a three-layer softshell fabric with an integrated 100% waterproof, windproof and breathable membrane. This is your shield against cold weather and spray. The protective three-layer fabric has a high-stretch profile to allow for a close and comfortable fit, while the raglan sleeves of the jacket allow freedom of movement and the raw cut sleeve cuffs give an effective seal around your wrists.

On areas not using the fully waterproof membrane fabric, such as the underside of the sleeves and upper back, a soft brushed fleece fabric is used to provide added breathability and further body-mapping stretch. This fleece fabric, as with the softshell fabric, is treated with a Durable Water Repellent (DWR) treatment – so it effectively shrugs of rain showers and spray.

A YKK® Vislon two-way zip, with extra-long zip pulls, is used on the jacket to allow you to regulate airflow through your layers with ease and avoid over-heating when you are working hard. Or, when conditions deteriorate, you can zip the jacket right up to the high cut collar and seal out the elements. A silicone gripper on the rear hem ensures the jacket stays firmly in place, no matter how hard you are working.

On the rear of the jacket there are three large open top pockets for all those long ride essentials, plus a single zipped pocket for small valuables. Reflective detailing on the rear helps to enhance your road presence in low light conditions.

The PACR Windproof Winter Jacket will keep you warm and comfortable no matter how tough the riding gets.

Drawing from two decades of experience in crafting cycling gloves, the GripGrab Expert RC Max Padded Short Finger Gloves mark the next level in glove design, succeeding the renowned GripGrab SuperGel gloves. These gloves excel in every aspect expected of summer cycling gloves, providing enduring comfort and superior protection while enhancing durability. Crafted with a focus on quality and durability, these gloves are designed to be your enduring cycling companion.

description:
Keeping the wind off your head without making your head too hot is a difficult balance when cycling in the winter months, but this is where the GripGrab Thermo Windproof Winter Headband is the ideal choice for winter cycling headwear.

This headband protects your forehead from windchill in cool conditions — the flexible windproof fabric sits against the skin but leaves the top of your head uncovered to allow excess heat to escape when you are working hard on a climb or pushing to keep up with you cycling friends.

The warm, soft and stretchy fleece lining to the fabric offers insulation and comfort in colder weather – to keep your head and ears warm and allow you to concentrate on the road ahead rather than the windchill.

The headband is lightweight thanks to its low-bulk fleece fabric; it is also highly breathable and has a high warmth-to-weight ratio, ideal for those cooler rides.

The comfortable under-helmet fit comes thanks to the stretchy contoured shape and flatlock stitching, which together allow a close fit under a cycling helmet.

Reflective logos and detailing on the front and rear help to improve your presence in low light winter conditions, when indeed you are most likely to be wearing the GripGrab Thermo Windproof Winter Headband.

For anyone who likes to run and hike in the winter, as well as cycle, this headband has wide multi-sport appeal as it keeps the windchill at bay regardless of the activity you choose.

name: GripGrab AquaRepel 2 Water-Resistant Leg Warmers
description:
The GripGrab AquaRepel 2 Water-Resistant Leg Warmers provide next-level weather protection. Featuring a three-layer construction: with a 100% waterproof, windproof and breathable membrane integrated into the fabric – they offer a complete shield for your lower legs in cold and wet weather.

The three-layer softshell fabric, with integrated waterproof and windproof membrane, is used on the complete lower portion of the leg warmers. This protective four-way stretch fabric creates a wrap-around armour against rain and road spray; a welded seam is used rather than a traditional stitched seam, as it allows for a 100% waterproof join in the material – completing the protection.

A raw cut hem on the bottom of the warmers completes the new Version 2.0 ‘high-stretch’ design – it means the fabric here also has greater stretch than a stitched cuff – making it easier to fit and remove the warmers, and to wear them over the top of waterproof shoe cover cuffs to reduce water ingress.

On areas not using the fully waterproof membrane fabric, such as the back of the upper leg, a soft brushed fabric is used to offer added insulation and further body-mapping stretch. A Durable Water Repellent (DWR) coating has been applied to all fabrics, so they effectively shrug off light rain and spray.

Elasticated silicone grippers on the upper hem of the leg warmers keep everything securely in place, no matter how hard you are working.

Protective, flexible and made to fit like a second skin. Version 2.0 of the GripGrab AquaRepel Leg Warmers has been fully optimised to provide exceptional comfort even in the worst weather conditions. Combine these weatherproof warmers with the GripGrab AquaRepel Bib Shorts for a versatile all-season wear package – you will be kept warm and comfortable as you ride through the wettest conditions.

name: GripGrab Women's ThermaShell Water-Resistant Bib Tights
description:
To keep riding through autumn and winter you need apparel that will shield you from the elements and make you feel comfortable heading out in all conditions. The GripGrab ThermaShell Water-Resistant Bib Tights are your leg wear solution – a versatile construction offering waterproof and windproof protection with great insulation against rough riding weather.

These bib tights utilise the same high-stretch softshell fabric as the GripGrab AquaRepel Leg Warmers: this three-layer fabric features a 100% waterproof, windproof and breathable membrane to shield your entire legs and lower back from the worst winter weather and rear wheel spray. The protective fabric has a four-way stretch profile to allow for a close and comfortable fit, with maximum freedom of movement.

In areas without the fully waterproof membrane fabric, such as the underside of the thighs, back of the knees and waist, a soft brushed fleece fabric is used to offer added insulation and body-mapping stretch. This fleece fabric, like the other fabric panels, is treated with a Durable Water Repellent (DWR) treatment – so it effectively shrugs off rain showers and rear wheel spray.

The padding in the ThermaShell Bib Tights is unique – it comes in the form of a superior level seatpad fitted within removable GripGrab Ventilite Padded Liner Shorts – to wear underneath the unpadded outer bib tights.

The Elastic Interface LIÈGE HP seatpad guarantees comfort during long distance rides thanks to the high-density foam inserts; these are strategically positioned to offer pressure relief on the pelvic track, seat bones and perinea. The perfect combination of perforated foams of different densities ensures exceptional breathability and maximum freedom of movement.

The liner shorts themselves are made from a mix of high-stretch fabric and exceptionally breathable mesh, with a wide elastic waistband to minimise pressure points. Elastic grippers with silicone gripper dots on the hems keep the shorts firmly in place, even when worn underneath the tights.

When getting home, brush off the dirt off your tights while cleaning your bike – and they’re ready for the next ride. Meanwhile, you can keep the liner shorts on to complete your training with some core and stretch exercises indoor. The removable liner shorts concept means that you can wash the shorts without needing to wash the complete set of bib tights after each ride: this is better for the tights as they retain their waterproofing and performance for longer. This product construction will also allow you to ride during consecutive days without having to worry about washing and drying your bib tights, by simply rotating the inner shorts or Summer bibs that you wear under the long tights.

Further details include reflective elements that will help to enhance your road presence in low light conditions, as well as contoured flatlock seams that ensure a close comfortable fit, no matter how hard you are pedalling.

Designed in Denmark for the Scandinavian winters – these bib tights will keep you warm, comfortable and protected from the elements as you clock up those long cold rides.

name: GripGrab AquaRepel Water-Resistant Bib Shorts
description:
As summer fades, your summer cycling bib shorts become less optimal legwear: designed to offer maximum breathability, they will do little to shield your leg muscles and lower body from the arrival of cold and wet conditions. The GripGrab AquaRepel Water-Resistant Bib Shorts are your solution – a pair of comfortable padded bib shorts that offer waterproof and windproof protection, to keep you riding in comfort through the transition seasons and into winter.

These bib shorts utilise the same high-stretch softshell fabric as the GripGrab AquaRepel Leg Warmers: this three-layer fabric features a 100% waterproof, windproof and breathable membrane to shield your legs from cold weather and rear wheel spray. The protective fabric has a four-way stretch profile to allow for a close and comfortable fit, with maximum freedom of movement.

On areas not using the fully waterproof membrane fabric, such as the underside of the legs and waist, a soft brushed fleece fabric is used to offer added breathability and further body-mapping stretch. This fleece fabric, as with the other fabrics on the shorts, is treated with a Durable Water Repellent (DWR) treatment – so it too effectively shrugs of rain showers and spray.

The seatpad used in the AquaRepel Bib Shorts is from Italian market-leader Elastic Interface. The LIÈGE HP seatpad guarantees superior comfort during long distance rides thanks to the very high-density foam inserts. These are strategically positioned to offer pressure relief on the pelvic track, seat bones and perinea. The perfect combination of perforated foams of different densities ensures exceptional breathability and maximum freedom of movement.

Reflective details have been added to the bib shorts to help enhance your road presence in low light conditions, while silicone grippers on the leg hems and flatlock seams ensure the bib shorts stay firmly and comfortably in place, worn with or without leg warmers.

Designed in Denmark for the unpredictable Scandinavian autumn and winter, these bib shorts will keep you warm, comfortable and protected from the elements as you clock up those winter rides.

The GripGrab AquaRepel Water-Resistant Bib Shorts are your solution – a pair of comfortable padded bib shorts that offer waterproof and windproof protection, to keep you riding in comfort through the transition seasons and into winter.

These bib shorts utilise the same high-stretch softshell fabric as the GripGrab AquaRepel Leg Warmers: this three-layer fabric features a 100% waterproof, windproof and breathable membrane to shield your legs from cold weather and rear wheel spray. The protective fabric has a four-way stretch profile to allow for a close and comfortable fit, with maximum freedom of movement.

On areas not using the fully waterproof membrane fabric, such as the underside of the legs and waist, a soft brushed fleece fabric is used to offer added breathability and further body-mapping stretch. This fleece fabric, as with the other fabrics on the shorts, is treated with a Durable Water Repellent (DWR) treatment – so it too effectively shrugs of rain showers and spray.

The seatpad used in the AquaRepel Bib Shorts is from Italian market-leader Elastic Interface. The LIÈGE HP seatpad guarantees superior comfort during long distance rides thanks to the very high-density foam inserts. These are strategically positioned to offer pressure relief on the pelvic track, seat bones and perinea. The perfect combination of perforated foams of different densities ensures exceptional breathability and maximum freedom of movement.

Reflective details have been added to the bib shorts to help enhance your road presence in low light conditions, while silicone grippers on the leg hems and flatlock seams ensure the bib shorts stay firmly and comfortably in place, worn with or without leg warmers.

Designed in Denmark for the unpredictable Scandinavian autumn and winter, these bib shorts will keep you warm, comfortable and protected from the elements as you clock up those winter rides.

name: GripGrab Neoprene Wet Weather Gloves
description:
The GripGrab Neoprene Wet Weather Gloves are designed to be worn in the wettest riding conditions.

Neoprene gloves give great warmth and insulation even when wet; like in a wetsuit, the material traps a thin layer of water between the neoprene and the skin – so your hands will be wet, but they stay warm as your body heat warms that layer of trapped water. The robust neoprene material also has a natural rubber-like texture that helps to absorb shocks and vibrations; so you can get on and ride in comfort, even on rough roads and trails. Subtle reflective details will help to keep your hand signals visible, even as the weather deteriorates.

Keep riding, no matter how bad the rain gets.

name: GripGrab Flandrien Waterproof Road Shoe Covers
description:
The GripGrab Flandrien Waterproof Road Shoe Covers were inspired by the classic “Belgian Bootie” – used by Flandrien riders for decades. This modern take on the knitted cover sock keeps all the attributes of its historic predecessor: the soft fabric, stretch and close-fitting cut; but propels it into the modern age through water-resistant membrane technology.

These cycling shoe covers will shrug off showers, keep your feet dry and let you glide through puddles without concern. The three-layer construction with a fully waterproof membrane protects your feet from road spray and winter downpours. They are luxuriously soft and comfortable, but also feature reinforcement to the hems on the underside of each shoe cover to reduce wear.

The Flandrien Knitted Road Shoe Covers are minimalist in style and subtly branded, yet they deliver the height of modern technology. They will keep you comfortable in all weather, while preserving that true Classics style. The premium soft knitted fabric offers supreme warmth retention and protection from cool temperatures and wind chill, so these will keep you warm on winter rides as well as repelling road spray on wetter rides.

Thanks to the elasticated soft knit material, there is a close and comfortable fit around your cycling shoes with minimal fabric bulk. Comfort is furthered by the zipperless cuff design which reduces irritation, increases flexibility and extends the product life compared to standard zip designs.

FAQ: Will the GripGrab Flandrien Waterproof Road Shoe Covers keep my feet dry? The membrane in these cycling shoe covers is waterproof, so assuming you don’t drag them over cobbles and put holes in them, then they will keep your feet dry. There are limits however… hosepipes and knee-deep puddles, for example, will likely find a way inside.

GripGrab Pro Tip: To help reduce water seeping in through the top of these shoe covers we recommend you wear your water-resistant leg warmers or cycling bib tights over the top of the shoe cover cuff. We also recommend you seal vents and holes in the soles of your shoes to limit water ingress from below.

name: GripGrab AquaShield Waterproof Winter Road Shoe Covers
description:
The AquaShield Waterproof Winter Road Shoe Covers are built for road cyclists who keep riding when winter roads are cold, wet, and covered in spray. The extra-high cut is a key part of the protection: it reaches high up the lower leg to improve overlap with winter tights or leg warmers, helping shield the ankle, lower leg, and shoe opening from rain, road spray, and cold wind. This makes the shoe cover better suited to harsh wet-weather riding than a lower-cut shoe cover.

Coated 3 mm neoprene provides flexible insulation and helps resist water from rain and spray. Waterproofed seams reduce water ingress through stitch lines. IntelliSeal™ technology reinforces the lower edge, a critical area where grit, grime, road spray, and repeated ground contact put shoe covers under constant stress.

The design is built for repeated winter use. An anti-abrasion tread pad adds a tough layer under the sole for repeated ground contact, while crank-rub protection helps guard the inner panels from repeated contact with the crank arm. Reflective details help increase visibility in low-light winter conditions.

Designed for cold, wet road rides, the AquaShield Waterproof Winter Road Shoe Covers deliver extra-high waterproof coverage, warmth, and durability when standard shoe covers are not enough. Like all cycling shoe covers, water may still enter through unavoidable openings such as the cleat/sole area or top cuff in prolonged heavy rain.

description:
The GripGrab FastStream Aero Dial Covers are engineered for high-speed road and gravel cycling, targeting one of the most aerodynamically disruptive areas of modern cycling shoes. By smoothing airflow over protruding fastening dials, they are designed to reduce aerodynamic disturbance with minimal added weight. In controlled aerodynamic testing, the dial covers demonstrated measurable aerodynamic savings of up to 8 watts at 45 km/h.

A PU-coated stretch fabric is used to focus coverage on the fastening dial area, creating a continuous surface where airflow disruption is typically highest. A close-fitting slip-on construction delivers a streamlined profile while allowing airflow to uncovered areas of the shoe.

With a weight of just 18 grams per pair, the FastStream Aero Dial Covers add negligible mass to the rider’s setup while delivering targeted aerodynamic benefit.

Developed and tested in collaboration with professional road cycling teams, the FastStream Aero Dial Covers are positioned as a focused aerodynamic alternative to full shoe covers. They are compatible with road and gravel cycling shoes but are not reinforced for off-road or heavy gravel use.

The dial covers are designed to pair with the GripGrab FastStream Aero Cycling Socks to create a clean aerodynamic interface around the ankle and lower leg.

The GripGrab AquaShield 2 Waterproof Gravel Shoe Covers are an evolution of the renowned GripGrab AquaShield, with a stronger construction and increased ease of use. They are now available in both a road version and this gravel version.

The zipperless design and anatomic cut offer a high level of comfort and waterproofing. The fabric's stretch allows you to adjust the shoe cover on your leg before putting on your shoes. The cuff should sit just underneath the calf muscle for optimal leg and sock protection. You can then put your shoes on and stretch the cover over them, securing them with the hook and loop closure under the sole.

This Gravel version of the AquaShield 2 combines PU-coated polyester with neoprene and Kevlar. The toe area is protected with a rubber insert to prevent damage when stopping and walking, while Kevlar is used underneath the forefoot for extra durability. These two elements help protect the PU body of the shoe cover from damage caused by tires, pedals, and vegetation. The opening in the base is specifically designed for gravel shoes with small cleats such as SPD and rubber sole lugs.

The GripGrab AquaShield 2 Waterproof Gravel Shoe Covers are high-performance, close-fitting cycling shoe covers optimised for waterproofness and durability while remaining easy to use and comfortable. Don't let the weather stop you from cycling!

name: GripGrab W's PACR Windproof Lightweight Vest
description:
A lightweight packable shield against windchill – the GripGrab PACR Windproof Lightweight Vest is a versatile and minimalist addition to your kit, which could make all the difference to your comfort on cool windy days and long descents.

Featuring a windproof front panel made from premium Japanese windproof fabric, this vest will help shield your torso from oncoming air particles that induce windchill on cool windy days. name: GripGrab WindBreaking Thermal Short Sleeve Base Layer
description:
True to its name, a WindBreaking base layer keeps the chill off your chest on those long descents or blustery days, without the need for a gilet for extra protection.

The GripGrab WindBreaking Thermal Short Sleeve Base Layer uses Arrowind™ fabric technology to protect you from windchill by creating a flexible protective barrier on the front torso and shoulders of the base layer. This unique warp knit construction blocks 80% of windchill-inducing air particles, while remaining as breathable as any other warp knitted base layer.

The WindBreaking fabric offers far better breathability and temperature regulation than two-layer windproof fabrics; while most air is stopped from reaching your skin, the little that is allowed through will carry away perspiration to keep you dry and comfortable.

A WindBreaking base layer is an excellent choice for anyone who often wears a gilet on their rides; to protect them from windchill on long descents or blustery exposed roads. The wind-resistant base layer allows you to leave your gilet at home, and adopt a sleeker and lighter weight clothing set-up.

This base layer utilises Polygiene® fabric treatment (biocide: silver chloride) to reduce the growth of odour-causing bacteria; this unique fabric treatment is completely safe for next-to-skin wear, but should mean your base layer needs less frequent washing, which is better for the product.

Leave your gilet at home, and adopt a sleeker and lighter weight clothing set-up with this WindBreaking shield.

Cycling caps are also a good addition under your helmet in the spring and autumn, as they keep the early morning chill from your head before keeping the sun off your head later in the day. The cap also provides effective protection from insects, and the absorbent cotton fabric stops sweat from running down into your eyes.

name: GripGrab PACR Windproof Winter Jacket
description:
When the temperature drops, reach for the GripGrab PACR Windproof Winter Jacket. This softshell winter jacket will keep you comfortable during your cold bike rides.

The front facing torso, lower back and sleeves of the jacket use a three-layer softshell fabric with an integrated 100% waterproof, windproof and breathable membrane. This is your shield against cold weather and spray. The protective three-layer fabric has a high-stretch profile to allow for a close and comfortable fit, while the raglan sleeves of the jacket allow freedom of movement and the raw cut sleeve cuffs give an effective seal around your wrists.

On areas not using the fully waterproof membrane fabric, such as the underside of the sleeves and upper back, a soft brushed fleece fabric is used to provide added breathability and further body-mapping stretch. This fleece fabric, as with the softshell fabric, is treated with a Durable Water Repellent (DWR) treatment – so it effectively shrugs of rain showers and spray.

A YKK® Vislon two-way zip, with extra-long zip pulls, is used on the jacket to allow you to regulate airflow through your layers with ease and avoid over-heating when you are working hard. Or, when conditions deteriorate, you can zip the jacket right up to the high cut collar and seal out the elements. A silicone gripper on the rear hem ensures the jacket stays firmly in place, no matter how hard you are working.

On the rear of the jacket there are three large open top pockets for all those long ride essentials, plus a single zipped pocket for small valuables. Reflective detailing on the rear helps to enhance your road presence in low light conditions.

The PACR Windproof Winter Jacket will keep you warm and comfortable no matter how tough the riding gets.

name: GripGrab CyclinGaiter Hi-Vis Shoe Cover Cuffs
description:
The CyclinGaiter Hi-Vis Shoe Cover Cuffs are ingenious products from GripGrab – waterproof coated neoprene cuffs to create a more watertight seal between the top cuff of your cycling shoes covers and your legs.

The addition of the CyclinGaiter extends the height of your shoe covers or winter MTB boots up your legs to offer greater coverage against front wheel spray.

The 2.5mm neoprene is windproof, waterproof and insulating. This helps to keep your ankles and lower legs drier and warmer on damp rides on wet roads and trails.

For optimum performance we suggest that you wear the CyclinGaiters next to your skin with your leg warmers or tights over the top. This provides a hidden barrier against spray and puddles, and improves the ‘seal’.

Use the CyclinGaiter with shoe covers or MTB waterproof winter boots to enhance the seal around your lower leg and improve their wet weather performance. Keep riding in comfort, in all weather conditions.

This neck warmer has a two-part fabric design, with an extra insulating fleece lower and a lighter weight and highly breathable upper. This design makes it particularly effective at sealing in the warmth around the collar of your winter jacket, while being flexible to pull up and cover your upper neck or mouth.

However, and the clue is in the name, this is a multifunctional and highly versatile bit of cycling kit and it can be worn in a number of ways: such as a bandana, scarf, snood, headband, wristband or face mask.

What’s more, it is perfect for all winter sports: cycling, skiing, hiking, trekking, mountaineering and much more.

name: GripGrab PACR Winter Jacket
description:
The PACR Winter Jacket is built for performance road and gravel riders who need windproof protection, breathable warmth, and a close fit for fast riding in cold conditions. The Windtex Softshell 3-layer fabric blocks cold wind, while a water-repellent outer finish helps light rain and road spray bead off the fabric. This makes the jacket well suited to cold, dry, and changeable winter rides where wind protection, temperature regulation, and fit precision matter.

The waffled inner surface supports insulation and moisture management as effort levels change, while thermal stretch fabric improves comfort and freedom of movement on the bike. The race fit is shaped for a forward-leaning cycling position, with raglan sleeves and articulated arms supporting natural movement during fast winter riding.

Bonded hems, bonded cuffs, a high collar, and extended back length help create a close, protective fit with minimal excess material. A 2-way YKK front zipper allows ventilation adjustment and easier access while riding. Three rear pockets and a smaller zipped rear pocket provide space for ride essentials, while reflective details on the cuffs and back help increase visibility in low-light conditions.

Built as part of the PACR winter riding system, this jacket is designed to be worn over the PACR Winter Seamless Long Sleeve Base Layer. In very cold conditions, it can be combined with the PACR Insulated Mid-Layer Vest for additional warmth. It is not intended as a fully waterproof rain jacket or as a heavily insulated deep-winter jacket.

name: GripGrab AquaShield 2 Waterproof Road Shoe Covers
description:
The GripGrab AquaShield 2 Waterproof Road Shoe Covers are an evolution of the renowned GripGrab AquaShield, with a stronger construction and increased ease of use.

The zipperless design and anatomic cut offer a high level of comfort and waterproofing. The fabric's stretch allows you to adjust the shoe cover on your leg before putting on your shoes. The cuff should sit just underneath the calf muscle for optimal leg and sock protection. You can then put your shoes on and stretch the cover over them, securing them with the hook and loop closure under the sole.

The design of these road shoe covers combines PU-coated polyester and waterproof neoprene. The opening in the base is specifically developed for large road cleats. The edge of the neoprene has a new IntelliSeal silicone edge to create a seal around the base to stop water ingress. The toe area has a new rubber insert to protect from damage when stopping and walking.

The GripGrab AquaShield 2 Waterproof Road Shoe Covers are high-performance, close-fitting cycling shoe covers optimised for waterproofness and durability while remaining easy to use and comfortable. Pro tip: Remember to seal the ventilation holes included in the soles of many road cycling shoes to avoid getting wet feet from water penetrating from under the soles. You can do so by removing the inner sole of your shoes, tape the holes inside, and put the sole in place again. Don't let the weather stop you from cycling!

name: GripGrab FastStream Aero Shoe Covers
description:
The GripGrab FastStream Aero Shoe Covers are engineered for high-speed road cycling, where marginal aerodynamic gains matter. By smoothing airflow around the cycling shoes in a highly turbulent area, they deliver measurable aerodynamic savings of up to 10 watts at 45 km/h in controlled testing.

The shoe covers are constructed from a stretch fabric with a smooth, PU-coated exterior. Fully sealed seams and a continuous outer surface help maintain clean, uninterrupted airflow across the shoe. An integrated tread pad under the toe improves durability and wear resistance when walking.

The low-cut construction extends slightly above the ankle and is designed to integrate cleanly with aero socks. A tight slip-on fit is combined with an adjustable hook-and-loop strap with cut-to-length capability, allowing the fit to be secured while minimising excess material.

The shoe covers form part of the FastStream aero concept, focused on reducing aerodynamic disruption around the shoe and lower leg. They are intended to be paired with the GripGrab FastStream Aero Cycling Socks to create a clean, continuous aerodynamic interface. The shoe covers are compatible with road cycling shoes only and are designed to work with both lace and dial-based closure systems.

They provide wind protection and limited resistance to water and road spray over the covered areas. Due to the close, race-oriented construction, careful fitting is required.

To keep you fresh and odour-free, this base layer features Polygiene® treatment (biocide: silver chloride). Its 'Wear More. description:

name: GripGrab ThermaShell Water-Resistant Bib Tights
description:
To keep riding through autumn and winter you need apparel that will shield you from the elements and make you feel comfortable heading out in all conditions. The GripGrab ThermaShell Water-Resistant Bib Tights are your leg wear solution – a versatile construction offering waterproof and windproof protection with great insulation against rough riding weather.

These bib tights utilise the same high-stretch softshell fabric as the GripGrab AquaRepel Leg Warmers: this three-layer fabric features a 100% waterproof, windproof and breathable membrane to shield your entire legs and lower back from the worst winter weather and rear wheel spray. The protective fabric has a four-way stretch profile to allow for a close and comfortable fit, with maximum freedom of movement.

In areas without the fully waterproof membrane fabric, such as the underside of the thighs, back of the knees and waist, a soft brushed fleece fabric is used to offer added insulation and body-mapping stretch. This fleece fabric, like the other fabric panels, is treated with a Durable Water Repellent (DWR) treatment – so it effectively shrugs off rain showers and rear wheel spray.

The padding in the ThermaShell Bib Tights is unique – it comes in the form of a superior level seatpad fitted within removable GripGrab Ventilite Padded Liner Shorts – to wear underneath the unpadded outer bib tights.

The Elastic Interface LIÈGE HP seatpad guarantees comfort during long distance rides thanks to the high-density foam inserts; these are strategically positioned to offer pressure relief on the pelvic track, seat bones and perinea. The perfect combination of perforated foams of different densities ensures exceptional breathability and maximum freedom of movement.

The liner shorts themselves are made from a mix of high-stretch fabric and exceptionally breathable mesh, with a wide elastic waistband to minimise pressure points. Elastic grippers with silicone gripper dots on the hems keep the shorts firmly in place, even when worn underneath the tights.

When getting home, brush off the dirt off your tights while cleaning your bike – and they’re ready for the next ride. Meanwhile, you can keep the liner shorts on to complete your training with some core and stretch exercises indoor. The removable liner shorts concept means that you can wash the shorts without needing to wash the complete set of bib tights after each ride: this is better for the tights as they retain their waterproofing and performance for longer. This product construction will also allow you to ride during consecutive days without having to worry about washing and drying your bib tights, by simply rotating the inner shorts or Summer bibs that you wear under the long tights.

Further details include reflective elements that will help to enhance your road presence in low light conditions, as well as contoured flatlock seams that ensure a close comfortable fit, no matter how hard you are pedalling.

Designed in Denmark for the Scandinavian winters – these bib tights will keep you warm, comfortable and protected from the elements as you clock up those long cold rides.

name: GripGrab Hi-Vis Windproof Road Toe Covers
description:
The GripGrab Hi-Vis Windproof Road Toe Covers are a versatile and multi-season piece of kit that can find a place in every cyclist’s kit drawer. Worn on their own over a pair of road cycling shoes, these toe covers offer wind chill protection and a lightweight extra layer of insulation for your toes on those early morning rides, particularly on cool spring and autumn days.

Combined with a light pair of waterproof overshoes, toe covers can also offer a transitional level of warmth to your toes when it isn’t yet cold enough for full winter overshoes, but you are likely to encounter rain and wet roads.

The toe covers themselves have a level of water resistance and the stretch fabric helps shield your toes from light wheel spray and mist.

When attached to the front of your cycling shoes, the GripGrab Hi-Vis Windproof Road Toe Covers are right in harm’s way; but the aramid-fibre wear reinforcements on the underside help reduce scuffing and improve product lifespan.

Autumn and winter rides are often done in low light conditions, so the reflective logo print helps to improve your road presence in low light and low visibility conditions.

These road cycling toe covers are easy to fit with their slip-on high-stretch design. They easily go over road cycling shoes thanks to the pre-cut reinforced cleat holes. Easy on before a ride and easy off during – if your toes get too warm; they are a versatile accessory and small enough to stow in your jersey pocket.

The shoulders and sleeves use a tighter, smoother knit construction to reduce bulk, support stretch recovery, and create a clean interface under race-fit jerseys and winter jackets.

Seamless zone transitions help create a uniform next-to-skin feel, reducing friction and pressure points during prolonged rides. Integrated rib-knit cuffs and hem help keep the garment in position and reduce cold air entry without added elastic components. A moisture-wicking, fast-drying fibre blend supports efficient moisture transport during high-intensity riding, while the Polygiene® treatment helps limit odour build-up during repeated use.

With its close second-skin profile and standard base-layer length, this is the primary interface layer for cold rides under the PACR Winter Jacket. In very cold conditions, it can be combined with the PACR Insulated Mid-Layer Vest for additional insulation.

The lightweight high-stretch material of these overshoes stretches over your road cycling shoes to create a smoother airflow as you turn the pedals – reducing the loss of watts sacrificed to drag.

These cycling shoes covers are for dry summer road rides, not for off-roading or wet conditions – get aero and stylish on the warmest summer days.

name: GripGrab W's PACR Padded Liner Shorts
description:
Designed for versatility the GripGrab PACR Padded Liner Shorts are made to be worn underneath unpadded bib tights, such as the GripGrab ThermaShell Bib Tights; these liner shorts feature an Elastic Interface seatpad for pressure relief, and highly breathable fabrics for the best temperature regulation. The padded waist shorts are also perfect for your indoor training sessions or even underneath baggy shorts.

The Elastic Interface LIÈGE HP seatpad guarantees comfort during long distance rides thanks to the high-density foam inserts; these are strategically positioned to offer pressure relief on the pelvic track, seat bones and perinea. The perfect combination of perforated foams of different densities ensures breathability and maximum freedom of movement.

The fabric of these liner shorts is a mix of high-stretch material and an open mesh material that provides maximum breathability. This combination means the shorts fit like a second skin and allow heat and perspiration to easily escape from within.

A wide elastic waistband and silicone leg grippers keep the liner shorts firmly in place, even when they are worn underneath close-fitting bib tights or baggy shorts.

The removable liner shorts concept means that you can wash the liner shorts without needing to wash your bib tights after each ride: this is better for the bib tights. These liner shorts are also perfect for use with baggy shorts or for indoor trainer use – they offer the same functionality as a normal pair of cycling shorts, but with enhanced breathability.

Versatile padded liner shorts that will offer you the comfort you need for long distance rides.
